summary: V32 — Bayi Impersonation, Plan Matrix History, Bayi Server Register, 30+ feature PLAN_FEATURES_DEFAULT — 29/29 pytest backend PASSING + full frontend UI verified. Impersonation lifecycle (start→cookie→bayi-scoped /plugin/status,/engines→stop) works end-to-end. POST /admin/plan-matrix now returns {changes:N} with diff logging to plan_matrix_history; GET /admin/plan-matrix/history returns items[] with action/actor_ip/changes/changes_count/at fields. Reset action logged as action='reset'. Non-master → 403 on all admin endpoints. Bayi server register is idempotent (same owner_license_key updates in place). Master /admin/bayi-servers enriches with customer_name/plan/license_active. /bayi/my-server returns install/logtail/test-ingest commands with license key embedded. PLAN_FEATURES_DEFAULT has 30 keys per plan (29 features + label) covering all requested modules. Frontend: 6 feature groups × 29 rows render, edit/history tabs work, ImpersonatePicker dropdown lists 23 bayis, red ImpersonationBar shows on impersonate + 'Master'a Dön' clears cookie. /panel/my-server renders 6 form fields + 3 CommandBlocks with copy + 'Nasıl çalışır' section. Full regression on 10 prior endpoints + blacklist/check + analytics/plan-event + broadcast-refresh + master-unlock all 200/expected.

minor.issue: Parameter is named `license_key_arg` (line 4791) instead of `license_key` — inconsistent with every other master-guarded endpoint that uses `license_key`. Master auth via query param would silently fail if a client sent `?license_key=...`. Works today because tests use `x-master-key` header. Recommend renaming to `license_key` for consistency.

The endpoint does NOT read the gws_impersonate cookie. Only accepts explicit ?license_key= arg. Frontend must therefore know to pass the impersonated key. If PlanConfig-consuming pages use the license from localStorage (gws.master_license), they will see master-scoped features (enterprise) even while impersonation cookie is active. Consider making /plan/features cookie-aware for full symmetry with /plugin/status.

action_items: (Minor) Rename admin_impersonate_start parameter `license_key_arg` → `license_key` for consistency with other master-guarded endpoints.
(Minor) Consider making /plan/features honor gws_impersonate cookie so impersonation shows bayi's plan features without an explicit ?license_key argument.
(Preserved from iter25) _tenant_scope precedence for master-on-behalf-of-bayi rule creation via ?license_key= — still not fixed; documented in iter25 minor issue.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~5700 lines — high priority to split (plan_matrix.py, bayi_server.py, impersonate.py). Reviewing endpoint changes across such a monolith is fragile.
plan_matrix_history collection has no TTL/index; capped at limit=500 on GET but grows unbounded on disk. Consider a TTL index on `at` (e.g., 90 days) or a rolling cleanup job.

Impersonation cookie uses secure=False and httponly=False so JS-side status polls work, but that's an XSS risk vector: any injected script could steal or set the impersonation cookie. Consider httponly=True + a server-rendered flag in /admin/impersonate/status instead of JS-readable cookie.

Impersonation cookie has no CSRF protection on /admin/impersonate/start; only master-key check. If master session cookie exists in browser, a CSRF from another tab could pin impersonation. Consider requiring the master-key header (which it does today via _require_master) — verify frontend never falls back to cookie-only auth.

BayiServer.js — save button gated on hostname+primary_ip only; the field marked '*' but no client-side validation for IP format or hostname regex. Payload accepted server-side too. Low risk but adds bad data to admin listing.
seed_data_creation: Test bayi_servers doc for PANEL license — cleaned up in module teardown (delete_many + plan-matrix reset).
